description: Gabia authenticated account-scoped domain and DNS reads, plus separate public recursive DNS/HTTPS checks and local record-plan preparation. Authenticated mutations are not implemented.

capabilities.title: 보호 owner 조회와 현재 로그인 세션 pin 대조
capabilities.note: same-session user_id pin matched and lifehackailab.com was present in that owner's protected listing. The owner response contains no email; Google/GitHub email equality is unverified. The complete sanitized reader proof remains separate.

capabilities.title: 현재 owner의 도메인 목록에서 요청 도메인 확인
capabilities.note: The exact filtered target appeared on page 1. Exhaustive pagination of the full account domain inventory is not implemented or verified.

capabilities.title: owner 확인 후 해당 도메인의 A·AAAA·CNAME 설정 조회
capabilities.note: The derived receipt binds the owner pin and target-domain listing assertion to this same Node HTTP read. It records the two apex A rows and www CNAME at TTL 600. Gabia JSON may include or omit the final CNAME dot. Other record types are not returned by this adapter.

capabilities.title: 일반 Google UI 로그인으로 새 세션 확보
capabilities.blocker: A normal visible Google login was used in the existing Linux Chrome profile. This repository has no automated login/bootstrap helper; account selection was not shown and the Gabia response has no email for cross-account comparison. Session acquisition remains browser_automation.
capabilities.note: The implemented reader begins after a current session has been handed to it over stdin in memory.

capabilities.title: 세션 만료 후 Google 로그인 재개·갱신
capabilities.blocker: A current session was verified; expiry, cold restart, automatic refresh, cookie rotation recovery, and unattended renewal were not tested. Repeat the normal UI login and memory handoff when the session is rejected.

capabilities.title: 전체 계정 도메인 목록 페이지네이션 종료 확인
capabilities.blocker: The named read searches one target domain on page 1. Full account inventory traversal and its terminal condition are not implemented or verified.

capabilities.title: DNS 레코드 추가·수정과 독립 readback
capabilities.note: The source candidate is not an observed write request. No POST was sent, no writer exists, and no mutation/readback evidence is claimed.

capabilities.title: Google·Cloudflare 공개 재귀 resolver로 DNS 상태 확인
capabilities.note: The supplemental sanitized snapshot sanitizedverification/gabia-public-domain-check-2026-10-08.json reports both recursive resolvers matching A/CNAME records. This inventory capability is not a recorded_live checklist receipt and is not an authoritative DNS or Gabia account read.

capabilities.title: DNS 입력 계획의 형식·중복·CNAME 충돌 검사
capabilities.note: Preparation is local-only and does not submit DNS changes.

capabilities.title: 도메인 HTTPS 응답 도달성 확인
capabilities.note: HTTPS status is separate from DNS matching. The supplemental public check reported HTTP 429; its cause is unknown. This inventory capability does not assert a reachable HTTPS result.
